content.title: Solaris Engine
about: Solaris Engine is a custom 3D game engine developed as part of the "Motors de Videojocs" course at CITM (UPC).
It provides a component-based scene system, an editor-style UI, and an asset pipeline focused on iteration speed.
The engine was built in C/C++ (C++17) using SDL2 and OpenGL, and integrates tools such as ImGui and Assimp.
features: Entity/component system with parent-child hierarchy management
Editor panels (Hierarchy, Inspector, Assets) with object picking
Resource management with reference counting and dedicated asset folders
FBX import pipeline (Assimp) and custom mesh format optimization
Camera controls, frustum culling, and basic debugging utilities
learnings: Designing engine architecture around iteration speed and tooling
Building an asset pipeline (import, caching, and resource lifetime)
Debugging rendering and scene issues in a custom engine
Working in a small team on a shared codebase
